https://discord.com/channels/735394249863987241/735394249863987244/1494756873197322392 (Tower Defense Simulator Wiki Server) The '''Crystallizer''' was a structure that could be placed on the ground. Once placed, it would spit out balls of acid onto the path, which would leave acidic crystals on the path which would be used to damage enemies. This means it was effectively a toxic based [[Trapper]].[[File:Crystallizer Tower - Tower Defense Simulator|280px]] With upgrades, the crystals would gain the ability to make enemies vulnerable for a few seconds, presumably making them receive more damage. Despite its similarities to the [[Trapper]], the '''Crystallizer''' was a late-game oriented tower.[[File:CrystallizerLategameProof.png|280px]]
